messages:
lina.docs: FYI opened a PR to collapse several Optimize Toolkit snippets into a single toggle-based example. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4872

jamal.eng: Nice. Does it also include the migration notes for config renames?

lina.docs: yes — short mapping table and a one-paragraph explain for `microbatch_window_ms` and `max_tokens_batch`.

hari.opt: please add a tiny perf guidance: use small batch sizes for low-latency web calls, increase for steady throughput.

lina.docs: added. also included a minimal kv-prefetch example:
```yaml
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  window_ms: 50
  max_keys: 128
```

zoe.pm: add checklist: update SDK snippets to v1.7.0, run evals, QA smoke.

kelly.qa: I will run smoke tests tomorrow — js/go/python, sync+stream.

ci-bot: running docs lint + linkcheck for PR #4872

kelly.qa: CI reported one broken import in sample_go.md, fixed and pushed.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #4872

jamal.eng: tagging owners @optkit-samples and @docs. please track follow-up OPT-4199 for embedding parity across langs.

lina.docs: OPT-4199 created. will merge after QA signoff. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
